item.title: Duluth FC Names Will Maanstroem as New Head Coach
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- Duluth FC has a new head coach. Current UWS women’s soccer assistant Will Maanstroem will lead the BlueGreens this upcoming summer. He played at UWS from 2020 to 2024, where he had nine points as a defender. Maanstroem replaces Thomas Pazo. Categories: College, Sports
